title: Milan: incline intervals 5 x 5min + eccentric block
terrain: treadmill 10% incline, climbing only, zero descent
coachNotes: THE WEEK'S ONE HARD SESSION. Five by five at 10% is 25 minutes of quality with zero descent, which is the only kind of hard day an ITB history allows in a week with no recovery terrain. Hold the incline fixed and drop the speed if the heart rate runs over 95%; the reps are meant to be repeatable, and rep five should look like rep one. AMBER: cut to 4 reps, never shorten the rep. ECCENTRIC BLOCK, the reason this week exists. Single-leg step-downs 3x10 per leg from a 25-30cm box with a 4-second lowering; Nordic curls 3x5, slow lower; split squats 3x8 per leg, 4s down; side-lying hip abduction 3x15; Copenhagen planks 3x20s per side; single-leg calf raises 3x12. Quality over load, the lowering phase is the whole point. Milan Tue-Thu is the only gym window you have: Belgium has none, so this does not get postponed to the weekend. Second and last gym day before Belgium.
